_comment: FIVE DEMO PRODUCTS FOR THE PRE-HANDOVER WALKTHROUGH. Not the launch catalogue.
Every one is a real piece from `Girlyf Assets/`, with copy written against the
actual photograph. Titles carry a `Test ` prefix and every product carries the
`edit:demo` tag, so `npm run demo:seed -- --undo` can find and remove exactly
these and nothing else. Two guards, because the undo deletes products.
TITLE, PRICE AND DESCRIPTION ARE MEANT TO BE EDITED. That is why they live in
this file rather than in seed-demo.mjs. Handles, tags, SKUs and the free_size
metafield are still DERIVED — same rules as the fill sheet, same code path, so
the demo cannot drift from the architecture it is demonstrating.
WHY NO SIZED RING. A sized ring would demo the variant picker, but nothing in
the asset folder is photographed in S/M/L — both rings shot are visibly
open-backed. Inventing sizes for a piece that has none would put a wrong fact
in front of the client. The open ring demos the Free Size badge instead.
WHY NO COMBO. A combo needs `combo_items` linked by hand in the admin, and a
combo whose pieces do not exist yet is a broken product page. Add one after
Image paths are relative to the ASSETS FOLDER, which sits beside the repo and
is not checked in. Override its location with --assets <path>.

products.title: Test Bow Pendant Necklace
products.description: A soft gold bow on a chain beaded at intervals, so the light catches it more than once. Sits just below the collarbone.

images.alt: Gold bow pendant on a beaded chain, with matching bow studs behind it

products.title: Test Pearl Heart Necklace
products.description: A small heart set with mother of pearl, on a chain fine enough to disappear. The piece you stop noticing you are wearing.

images.alt: Gold heart pendant with a mother of pearl centre on a fine chain

products.title: Test Mother of Pearl Bangle
products.description: A hinged bangle inlaid with mother of pearl and clasped with a line of tiny stones. Slips on, stays put.

images.alt: Gold hinged bangle inlaid with mother of pearl panels
The bangle in a velvet tray beside three others, with a mirror behind

products.title: Test Emerald Vine Bracelet
products.description: Green stones set along a gold vine, leaves and all. Formal enough for the wedding, light enough for the dinner afterwards.

images.alt: Gold vine bracelet set with oval and marquise green stones

products.title: Test Wave Open Ring
products.description: A wide sculpted band that folds like water and leaves its back open, so it fits whichever finger you settle on.

images.alt: Wide sculpted gold ring, open at the back, on a suede tray

products.title: Test Clover Studs
products.description: Four small petals of mother of pearl, edged in beaded gold. Light enough for a full day and quiet enough for every one of them.

images.alt: Pair of gold clover studs set with mother of pearl on ivory satin

products.title: Test Ribbon Set
products.description: The bow pendant and its matching studs, boxed together and made to be worn at once. One bow at the collarbone, two at the ears.

images.alt: Gold bow pendant on a beaded chain with the matching bow studs behind it
